exposure: Open abdominal surgery vs. pelvic surgery (caesarean delivery or hysterectomy)
availability of postoperative preprinted order sets with fixed high doses of opioids
outcome: Daily doses of morphine milligram equivalents (MME) prescribed at hospital discharge
cohort: 1322 patients who underwent select open pelvic and open abdominal surgeries between January 1 and December 31, 2017, in a tertiary health care centre in Montreal
finding: Patients who underwent abdominal surgery were significantly more likely to receive high-risk opioid prescriptions at discharge compared to those who underwent pelvic surgery.
mod_finding: Patients who underwent a caesarean delivery were prescribed significantly lower daily doses of MME compared to those who underwent open abdominal surgeries.
